events: Daniel brings actual posted Rivermark case-mark notice. Heisenberg threatens future supply cutoff for buyers of stolen stock and offers unnumbered recovery-information reward. No completed sale invented.
Chris saves current RDR2 game before joining plan. Daniel proposes returning stock to secure larger score; Arthur and Billy independently agree.
Briar chooses north road and leaves voluntarily. Kaze and Samira continue toward coast with Naganeka; no new romance or membership.
Dessa attacks Daniel with iron bar; he catches it and sets it aside. She identifies E20 dead maul guard as Renn and describes wages withheld to cover losses.

Dessa bargains for six cases returned first and 300 silver if cash recovered. She plans to claim coerced escort later; no actual report or success of that claim shown. Billy releases all six intact into her office.
Workers cart six cases to Heisenberg collection house above old pumping cut; guards inspect them; workers dismissed. Dessa secures access, refuses delayed wage adjustment.
Serrat recognizes Daniel from Dessa report of tail, raises alarm and pulls cage-lift lever. Arthur controls two door rifle guards, strikes first jaw, no initial gunshot.
Daniel lands on descending cage, warns two clerks and senses harness worker below. Drug-enhanced loading-harness worker fights for promised additional vial.

Daniel is thrown through shaft brickwork, suffers brow cut/soreness, uses tail bracket and cloud to recover; spear/feet and two limited hair duplicates create final opening. Physical spear kills worker; corpse kicked onto lower ledge.

Chris opens brake housing and identifies linkage. Teemo warns of third rifle behind desk. Serrat fires once, misses as Chris ducks and deploys mask. Arthur disarms and punches Serrat, leaves him alive.

Chris wedges upper safety-gate latch with bent inspection cover. Billy immediately takes exterior and jumps onto cage. Arthur fires one charged revolver round through upper counterweight guide, jamming weight and stopping cage.

Daniel returns to gallery by cloud. Billy tears cage mounting feet loose and swallows entire cash cage, silver and trays into storage; both clerks separately contained alive. Billy climbs supports back up.

Arthur admitted inside; Chris opens damaged cage seam with pry tool. Arthur counts 300 silver, returns outside and pays Dessa. She counts it and leaves with six cases; Billy releases clerks, guards leave rifles.
Billy tears free and swallows bronze ornamental carp, breaking water feed and flooding Serrat desk. Basin/feed not acquired. Chris objects but later inadvertently claims it as his fountain.
Group returns behind loading ramp by late afternoon. Arthur/Daniel admitted; Billy yields to Chris exterior sentry. 2100 silver remains after 300 paid. No shares distributed.

Group discusses coast/Noxus and seeking Kaze, consulting Harl sketch and previous flight memory. Harbor inquiry is intended next, not already performed. Enjoyable win and domestic carp argument close scene.
